content: उच्छ्वासः .²1 Breath, exhalation, breathing out; मुखोच्छ्वासगन्धम् <ls>V. 4. 22</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Me. 104</ls>. .²2 Support of life, being alive; तदद्याप्युच्छ्वासो भवति <ls>U. 3. 30</ls>; <ls>K. 158</ls>. .²3 A sigh. .²4 Consolation, encouragement; <ls>Amaru. 13</ls>. .²5 Expiring, dying. .²6 An air-hole. .²7 A division or chapter of a book, as of the Harṣa-charita; <ab>cf.</ab> अध्याय. .²8 Froth, foam; सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणम् <ls>Rv. 9. 86. 43</ls>. .²9 Swelling up, rising, increasing.
